messages:
Noah (sales): Quick alert 00: Borealis Health POC seeing SSE streams drop and send partial JSON blobs. Mobile app shows UTF-8 decode errors and the SDK reconnects in a tight loop. Need help triaging.
Priya (eng): Which endpoint and client? Hosted API, our iOS/Android SDKs or custom? Any curl repro?
Noah (sales): Hosted API. They use our iOS SDK v1.2.5 and a custom Android client. Provided a curl dump and mobile logs.
Arun (devex): Typical culprits: edge buffering (CloudFront/ALB), proxy reassembly, or client parsing boundary rules. Share the raw stream snippet and any response headers.
Noah (sales): Snippet from their Android logs: 
```n2026-03-18T20:02:11.045Z ERROR SSEParser: Malformed event, unexpected EOF
raw recv: "data: {\"patient\": \"Jos\"\n"
```
Seems like an event was cut inside a multibyte char.
Zoe (solutions): Also check rate-limit logs. If they hit short 429 windows while reconnecting, some connections may be force-closed by upstream which results in half-flushed writes.
Noah (sales): They did see a burst of reconnects; ops shows a couple of 429s around the same time.
Priya (eng): Short-term server fixes: 1) emit SSE comments as keepalive every 12s (":\n\n") and flush after each event; 2) set headers to discourage buffering: `X-Accel-Buffering: no`, `Cache-Control: no-transform`, `Connection: keep-alive`; 3) if fronted by CloudFront, set `Origin-ReadTimeout` and disable response buffering rules.
Arun (devex): Client hardening: accumulate chunks and only parse when you detect the event delimiter (double newline). For UTF-8 safety, use a streaming decoder that preserves partial bytes until complete char sequences arrive. Example idea: use ByteBuffer, attempt decode; if MalformedInputException then wait for more bytes.
Zoe (solutions): For POC reliability, propose we spin up a short-lived dedicated ingress route for Borealis (avoids CloudFront). That reduces proxy-induced chunking. Requires infra + billing approval.
Noah (sales): Client wants no UX regressions during trial. Can infra do a quick dedicated route?
Priya (eng): We can provision a temporary route in ~2412h. I'll open the infra ticket and tag finance. Meanwhile, Arun 5 can you send a small client snippet (Android Java/Kotlin) that does buffering + jittered reconnects?
Arun (devex): Sure, I6ll paste a compact snippet and a curl test harness. Also recommend exponential backoff with randomized jitter to prevent stampeding and 429 cascades.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance note: streaming-gateway will deploy 2026-03-18-09:30UTC.
Noah (sales): Thanks everyone. I'll push the buffering snippet to the Borealis engineers and coordinate the dedicated route approval. Will post traces once they reproduce. :thumbsup:
Priya (eng): Thanks 5 keep us posted. If you can get a raw TCP capture or curl -v with `--raw` that would help pinpoint if truncation is proxy or server-side.
Noah (sales): Roger that, collecting artifacts now.
